defects_fixed: docker-offline red for 4 commits: judge/report.py counted .gitkeep as evidence, so the published artifact count was 21 in a checkout and 20 in the image (D-15-03). Found by turning CI failure output into readable annotations after job logs proved unreachable

C-locale crash: python:3.11-slim runs LC_ALL=C, so printing an em dash in test_doc_claims.setUpModule raised UnicodeEncodeError before verification began; all console output now goes through a transliterating _say() (TestLocaleSafety)
Container tmpfs masks the committed trajectories.jsonl and make verify never regenerates it; baseline rows became an optional, explicitly reported fact block
Read-only rootfs rejected the new doc-claims report directory; the report is now a convenience artifact whose write failure cannot turn PASS into a crash

Clean clone failed: both Phase 16 test modules gated on gitignored outputs, so RC-001 became SKIPPED -> exit 5, while the same tree passed locally (the D-15-01 bootstrap trap, reintroduced one directory over)
RC-001 read a gitignored report directly, so a clean clone raised FileNotFoundError; report-contract tests now drive the real CLI into a temp dir
The secrets audit found four credential shapes in its own test fixtures; fixtures are assembled at runtime so the audit need not exempt itself
The audit errored on a git-archive tree (no .git); .dockerignore excludes .git, so the submission image is exactly that case. Added a filesystem fallback and a complete ERROR envelope
FILELIST matched only one sealed/ depth and let a forced git add -f through while reporting PASS; now matches any depth
Entrypoint probe checked parameter count (1 for a bound method) instead of the returned 5-tuple
Adapter exposes no tool_names attribute; the vocabulary is now verified behaviourally by dispatching each tool in a fresh env
